/-- `f.IsBoundedUnder (≺) u`: the image of the filter `f` under `u` is eventually bounded w.r.t.
the relation `≺`, i.e. eventually, it is bounded by some uniform bound. -/
def IsBoundedUnder (r : α → α → Prop) (f : Filter β) (u : β → α) :=
  (map u f).IsBounded r
